title: CrowdStrike agrees to acquire Zscaler, which develops network security tools, for ~$43.9B in an all-stock deal, one of the largest-ever deals in the sector (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: CrowdStrike agrees to acquire Zscaler, which develops network security tools, for ~$43.9B in an all-stock deal, one of the largest-ever deals in the sector — CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. has agreed to acquire cybersecurity provider Zscaler Inc. in one of the largest-ever deals in the sector.
